notes.title: Introducing Levels!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/938331559625160964/37799780C3409F7996D6D06F968872E60C7F2B5D/[/img]

Levels have now been implemented. Levels will allow for tons of exciting new features such as weapons, armor, and more to come in the future.

In order to level up, you will need to gain XP through any of the main combat game modes. Currently, XP will only be available by playing 'Waves', however, it will be implemented to more game modes as they are added.

By attacking an enemy, you will gain XP. The amount of XP you will need to level up will depend on your current level.

Higher levels will grant you access to better weapons and armor which will aid you in fighting the enemies.

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/938331559625161175/5327FE3BE0E8BE2521895366E0823181B944DB4B/[/img]

There will be loads more weapon options available as we come closer to the release date on November, 2nd!

notes.title: Sandbox Editor
notes.content:
Sandbox has been added and will be available for all players on release. Sandbox allows you to spawn any amount of enemies at any time which is a fun and easy way to train for the other game modes.
You also have the option of using a few abilities such as god mode, super speed, and super strength.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GatcLbt.jpg[/img]

notes.content: The first [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=51nB0a2lBfo] trailer[/url] has now been released. This trailer is focused on showcasing the 'waves' game mode. More will be shown as we move closer to the release date on November 2nd.
